BrochureContent.Content: Modern Bungalow in excellent condition and which enjoys exceptional views of the Brandon Mountains in the Dingle Peninsula. Built c. 2000 the property is only a short stroll from the picturesque Brandon Creek. Accommodation comprises of a Front Porch, Living Room, Dining Area, Sunroom, Kitchen, Utility, Bathroom & 3 Bedrooms. Situated on c. 0.52 acres, the house is less than a 15 minute drive from Dingle Town.
